how_measured: Randomised trials of this robot and firmware; a rate is written [k, n]: k of n trials. Obstacle trials: the robot starts 0.7-0.9 m before the element with up to 0.12 m of lateral offset and is steered as each row says; 'approach' is the angle between the element's edge and square to the path. The commanded speed is drawn over the range given. A try ends at a 'blocked' report; the next try repeats the same command after a 1 s pause. Floors: dry, friction 0.8-0.9 unless stated. Odometry is not in these tables: see the datasheet's odometry entry.
